name: security
description: Essential security tools: Snapper system snapshots, KeePassXC password manager, UFW firewall, GnuPG
_comment: Note: Snapper snapshots, KeePassXC, UFW firewall, rsync, and GnuPG are active defaults. Advanced tools (VeraCrypt, WireGuard, OpenVPN, Wireshark, Nmap, BorgBackup, AppArmor) are in 'optional_packages'.
